grade_bands.description: No definition provided or completely incorrect.
Partial or vague definition — captures the general idea but lacks precision.
Clear, accurate definition explaining the division of a market into groups based on shared characteristics or needs.
No example provided or example is not a real South African business.
A South African business is named but the segmentation example is vague or incorrect.
A real South African business is named with a plausible segmentation example, but the explanation is superficial.
A real South African business is named with a clear, specific, and accurate example of how it uses market segmentation, well explained.
No strategy named or a completely irrelevant answer.
A strategy is implied but not named correctly or clearly.
A recognised business strategy (cost leadership, differentiation, or focus) is correctly identified and named.
No explanation provided.
Very brief or generic explanation with no real depth.
Basic explanation of the strategy that is mostly accurate.
Clear, accurate explanation of the strategy showing genuine understanding of the concept.

12.criterion: Link to Competitive Advantage with Example

grade_bands.description: No link made between the strategy and competitive advantage.
A vague link is made with no specific supporting example.
A link is made with a general example but lacks specificity or depth.
A clear, specific link is made between the strategy and competitive advantage, supported by a real and relevant example from the chosen company.
Response is incoherent or completely unstructured.
Some structure but writing is unclear or difficult to follow.
Well-structured and clearly written response that is easy to follow.
